newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close firmly, Ibex eyes 7,200 hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close firmly, Ibex eyes 7,200 hurdle.

text.p: MADRID, July 14 (Reuter) 1505 GMT - Madrid shares ended higher on Monday, backed by currency strength and gains on foreign markets in mainly trading-based turnover, dealers said. * General index adds 4.93 points, 0.76 percent, to 628.10 * Ibex gains 56.90 points, 0.8 percent, to 7,169.42 * Ibex resistance at 7,200 seen tested if Wall Street permits * Repsol soars 200 ptas to 6,550 on a big put through and news of a Latam natgas deal after an overhanging sell order ended, dealers said. Gas Natural up 100 ptas to 31,800. * Endesa up 260 pesetas to 12,760 amid some talk of strategic stake-building. Others ruled out core investor interest, adding that upside may be capped by the prospect of the public share offering.
Banesto ended flat at 1,495 pesetas after announcing first quarter earnings up 21.5 percent, in line with consensus forecasts, according to a Reuters poll.
